newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TOP CLUBS THROWN TOGETHER BY LYNAGH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TOP CLUBS THROWN TOGETHER BY LYNAGH.

text.p: Bath and Leicester, last year's finalists, have been drawn against each other in the last 16 of the Pilkington Cup, English rugby's domestic knock-out tournament.

The draw, conducted by former Wallaby captain Michael Lynagh on Monday, also paired Lynagh's club Saracens with London rivals Wasps next month, setting up an intriguing midfield duel between former All Black Va'aiga Tuigamala and French centre Philippe Sella.
